home.title: Report street problems in Prishtina | kosova.report
home.description: A pothole, a dead street light, bins overflowing? Report it with a photo and the exact spot, and it goes to the department that handles it.

report.title: Report a problem in Prishtina | kosova.report
report.description: Pick a category, drop a pin, add photos. Your report gets a number, a private key and a PDF receipt. You can report without your name.

track.title: Find your report | kosova.report
track.description: Check your report's progress with the report number and the private key you got after sending it.

cookies.title: Essential cookies only
cookies.intro: No ads and no analytics. We only use what the site needs to work.
cookies.essentialBody: Staff sign-in uses a security cookie. Your language and this notice are remembered on your device.
cookies.mapBody: Map tiles load from the map provider, which sees your IP address. It sets no cookies.
cookies.offlineBody: The app keeps only the offline page and icons on your device. Private reports are never cached. Your draft stays on this device until you send or delete it.
cookies.analyticsBody: Not used. There is nothing to switch on.

install.title: Keep kosova.report on your home screen
install.body: Open it like an app and report straight from the street, without looking for the site.
iosSteps: Tap the Share button at the bottom of the screen.
install.otherHelp: In other browsers, look for Install app in the browser menu.

infrastructure.name: Infrastructure
infrastructure.examples: A pothole, a broken pavement, a street light that's out, a missing sign.
infrastructure.short: Pothole, broken pavement, street light out
infrastructure.prompt: What exactly is broken? Since when? Is it dangerous for people walking or driving?

environment.name: Environment
environment.examples: Overflowing bins, rubbish dumped on a green space, trees cut down without a permit.
environment.short: Full bins, dumped rubbish, felled trees
environment.prompt: What do you see and how much of it? How long has it been like this? Does it keep happening here?

public_services.name: Public services
public_services.examples: Water cut off without notice, a bus that never comes, a blocked sewer.
public_services.short: Water cut off, bus not coming
public_services.prompt: Which service isn't working? Since when? How many people or homes does it affect?

administration.name: Administration
administration.examples: A document that's overdue, a counter nobody answers, information that's missing.
administration.short: Overdue document, no answer at the counter
administration.prompt: Which office or procedure? When did you apply? What answer did you get, if any?

health.name: Health
health.examples: A family health centre with no doctor during opening hours, long waits with no information, basic medicines missing.
health.short: No doctor on duty, waits with no information
health.prompt: Which institution? What happened and when? Please don't include personal health details.

education.name: Education
education.examples: A school without heating, an unsafe schoolyard, broken toilets.
education.prompt: Which school or kindergarten? What's the problem and since when? Who does it affect?

safety.name: Safety
safety.examples: A junction with no traffic lights, a park with no lighting at night, stray dogs near a school.
safety.prompt: Where exactly, and at what time of day is it worst? Have there been accidents?

home.lede: A pothole in Dardania, a dead street light in Ulpiana, bins overflowing by the bus station. Report what you see, with a photo and the exact spot, and it goes to the department that handles it.
home.citiesSoon: Live in Prishtina for now. More municipalities are coming in the near future.
home.see: See what a report looks like
home.disclaimerShort: This is not an emergency service. In an emergency, call

home.sampleText: Deep pothole in front of the school entrance. Cars swerve into the other lane to avoid it. It's been there since last week's rain.

how.title: One report, four parts
how.sub: Yes, it takes about two minutes. Most of that is finding the right spot on the map.

steps.title: Pick a category
steps.body: Seven areas, from roads to schools. The category decides which department receives the report.

steps.title: Drop the pin
steps.body: With your phone's location or one tap on the map. An exact spot saves a lot of questions later.

steps.title: Describe it, add a photo
steps.body: What's broken, since when, whether it's dangerous. A good photo says more than a paragraph.

steps.title: Send it and keep the proof
steps.body: You get a report number, a private key and a PDF receipt. Use them to follow the report later.

choice.title: With your name or without. Your call.
choice.anonymousBody: The department gets no contact details. You keep a private key and use it to check progress. Without the key, not even we can connect the report to you.
choice.namedBody: The department sees your email and can ask you for more detail. When the status changes, you get an email.
choice.keyCaption: Your private key. Only you have it.

home.categoriesSub: Pick an area and the report opens with it already chosen.

after.title: What happens after you send it

steps.title: The report goes to the department
steps.body: To the office that covers that category in your municipality, with the photos, the pin and your description.

steps.title: You have proof
steps.body: The report number, private key and PDF show that the report was sent, and when.

steps.title: The department updates the status
steps.body: When they mark it “Being handled” or “Resolved”, you see it with your key. If you left an email, you get a notice.

after.limits: This platform is not an emergency service. Submitting a report does not guarantee an immediate resolution. The department decides how and when to handle it.
